title: Pull-back Reveal
summary: The shot pulls back to reveal it is inside an editor app that is rendering it, with a % counter.
description: The full-frame footage smoothly shrinks into an editor window on a cream desk (title bar with the file name, the video keeps playing inside with its captions). An agent panel slides in and ticks through its steps with spinners, a render bar with a waveform and frame counter fills under the video, a big serif percentage rolls up to 100%, and on completion the window, bar and badge turn green. Optionally zooms back to full frame at the end.

options.doneAt: "auto" (about 0.7s before the end) or when the render completes and turns green
options.counterAt: "auto" (about 0.9s before done) or when the % counter starts rolling
options.returnAt: optional: when to zoom back to full frame (null = stay in the window; it returns automatically if the effect window ends before the clip)
options.filename: file name in the window's title bar
options.tab: label on the right of the title bar
options.skill: pill next to the panel header (the skill / command name)
options.steps: list of step labels that tick off in order; {frames} is replaced by the frame count
options.frames: "auto" (the clip's frame count) or a number for the render counter
options.accent: colour of the progress fill, skill pill and dots
options.windowX: left edge of the window, 0-1 of the width
options.videoAspect: width/height of the video area inside the window (0.5625 shows the full 9:16 frame)
options.panelX: left edge of the agent panel, 0-1 of the width
